scope: Page-load speech and keyboard focus, typed web searches, deletion feedback, and accessible HTML email controls.

topics.title: Type a web search
details: Press Ctrl+L from Companion web browsing, choose Web browsing on the main menu, or say Search the web to open a typed search field. Type a search and press Enter; Escape returns to the previous page or main menu. Standard text editing, caret movement, word movement and typing echo apply. Spoken searches remain available.

topics.title: Page loading and browser keyboard navigation
details: Loaded pages use operation-result speech instead of discardable caret feedback. A page revision restores Companion reading focus after opening, following links, going back or refreshing, including when the browsing mode has not changed. Native browser focus polling no longer replaces Companion browse-cursor announcements.

Use the Companion page reading area for arrows, quick keys, forms and table navigation. These controls share the same backend behavior for Firefox, Chrome, Edge and Brave. The release checks now exercise actual installed Chrome, Edge and Brave adapters as well as Firefox, including page loading, app focus, arrow speech and quick-key dispatch. Native browser windows retain their own keyboard behavior.
Website-address confirmation now accepts keyboard Y/N, arrow/Tab selection, Enter and Escape. Existing voice Yes/No and website confirmation remain.

topics.title: Backspace, Delete and blank feedback
details: Backspace announces the erased character. Delete announces the new character at the caret, to the right of the removed character, or End of text. Document and email editors, email header entries, typed commands and search entries use this feedback. Typing echo Off remains silent; password deletion stays private.
Keyboard and spoken blank-line reading now say Blank rather than Blank line.

topics.title: HTML email links and buttons
details: Reading HTML email announces link and button roles without adding those words to the text you copy. Donation links made from images retain their alternative text; empty labelled image anchors retain a usable label. Explicit button roles and passive HTML buttons are exposed.

Press K or Shift+K for next/previous link, B or Shift+B for next/previous button, Tab/Shift+Tab for controls and Enter to open. Say Next link, Previous link, Next button, Previous button, List links, List buttons, Activate current link or Activate current button. Numbered Open link and Open button commands remain available. Buttons without a safe URL are announced and cannot run email scripts.

Plain text email remains available. No remote images or email scripts are loaded by the passive email reader. Guided email composition, send review, provider safeguards and blank-subject/body sending remain.

topics.title: Help and release validation
details: Built-in Help includes the new typed-search and HTML email navigation instructions. What’s New and downloadable release notes use version 0.2.109-test.

Regression checks cover dropped page announcements, repeated page focus restoration, typed search submission/cancellation, browser adapter selection, deletion feedback, blank announcements, image donation links, role buttons, passive buttons and spoken control navigation. Windows checks additionally exercise actual Tk key events and the four browser runtimes. Real public-site testing remains necessary.
